title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A dynamic full-body illustration of a young female warrior with dark hair and purple eyes, mid-leap in an action pose. She wields a massive purple warhammer crackling with lightning energy, wearing a white and purple cropped top with geometric patterns, white pants with purple accents, and matching armored boots and gauntlets.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long dark hair and purple eyes leaping forward in an action stance, holding a giant purple warhammer with glowing lightning cracks.
